title: Advanced Desert Provision upgraded, Peak Palosseum text added
summary: This version upgrades the Advanced Desert Provision item from epic to legendary quality and adds the full text for a new Peak Palosseum (cross-server tiered ranked ladder) feature, plus assorted localization rewording across several existing systems.
highlights: Upgraded Advanced Desert Provision from purple (epic) to orange (legendary) quality.
Added the full text for Peak Palosseum, a new cross-server ranked ladder with Novice/Intermediate/Advanced tiers, weekly challenges, and tiered rewards.
Reworded several skill descriptions (Aqua Cannon, Blunt Sense, and others) to clarify they apply only against non-explorer targets.
